I'm a bit confused about whether to attribute the writer to the original artist or the cover artist. I think in this case, since the question is about who wrote the song that Norah Jones performed, it's the original writer, John D. Loudermilk.

Another source I found on Genius.com confirms that "Turn Me On" was written by John D. Loudermilk. This adds to the credibility.

I think I've got it now. The performer who did both "Sinkin' Soon" and "Turn Me On" is Norah Jones, and the writer of "Turn Me On" is John D. Loudermilk.
